create_gym_env: create a Gym environment by calling gym.make with a given environment name string
create_env: create multiple Gym environments wrapped with TimeLimit and returned as a GymEnv batch
create_train_env: create multiple Gym environments wrapped with TimeLimit and returned as a GymEnvInf batch for training
create_agent: create a RecurrentAgent instance with a given model and number of actions
run_Experiment: run an A2C experiment on CartPole-v0 by instantiating Experiment with a config dict and calling run
